heading.title: Market share of Tesla vehicles by region (TTM)

figures.source_line: Source: Tesla estimates based on latest available data from ACEA; Autonews.com; CAAM – light-duty vehicles only

components.evidence: bordered table with grey header row 'Region | Model | Capacity | Status' under its own bold caption
Capacity cells read '-' for 'Tesla Semi', 'Next Gen Platform' and 'Roadster'
small grey note below table: 'Installed capacity ≠ current production rate and there may be limitations...'
'Source: Tesla estimates based on latest available data from ACEA...' and 'TTM = Trailing twelve months'
'US/Canada  Europe  China' row sits between the table note and the 4% tick
faint horizontal rules at 0%,1%,2%,3%,4%; no vertical grid lines drawn
'Q3 2017'…'Q3 2023' tick labels set at roughly 45 degrees under the axis
time written as 'Q3 2017', 'Q1 2018' rather than ISO dates
capacity table and market-share line chart each carry their own caption and note lines
left column prose 'US: California, Nevada and Texas', 'China: Shanghai' runs level with both figures

new_components.name: chart_title_below_plot
new_components.evidence: 'Market share of Tesla vehicles by region (TTM)' printed under the x tick labels, above the source line
new_components.why_it_matters: 图题在坐标轴下方且紧挨来源行，解析时容易被并入注释或归到下一个块，导致折线图的数值失去标题上下文。

new_components.name: inequality_qualified_values
new_components.evidence: Capacity cells read '>950,000', '>250,000', '>125,000' rather than plain numbers
new_components.why_it_matters: 数值带有大于号前缀，检索纯数字时无法精确匹配，读数还需保留“下限”这一语义。

new_components.name: blank_cell_row_grouping
new_components.evidence: second California row and Cybertruck row leave the 'Region' cell empty, inheriting the row above
new_components.why_it_matters: 区域标签靠空单元格继承，若不回填，'550,000' 与 '>125,000' 就无法唯一定位到 California / Texas。

new_components.name: zebra_row_shading
new_components.evidence: alternating white and light-grey row bands under the dark grey header row
new_components.why_it_matters: 行底色交替只是分行提示，不编码数据，但会影响表格边界识别与行对齐。

difficulty_notes: 全部被评分的数值都落在 f2 折线图上，图上无任何数字标签，纵轴只有 0%、1%、2%、3%、4% 五个刻度，1 个百分点约占 85 像素。要把 0.1、0.15、0.2 这类点读到 5% 相对误差，等于要求 0.005–0.01 个百分点的精度，即不到 1 像素，凭像素不可能达到；即便 4.0、2.8 这样的大值，5% 也只有 0.14–0.2 个百分点，约 12–17 像素，还得在 25 个横向密集季度刻度中先对准正确的 x 位置（相邻季度间距约 40 像素，标签又旋转 45 度）。相比之下标签只需「系列名 + 季度」两个键，表格容易承载；标题虽在图下方但为粗体，属可解决问题。

suggestions.what_to_add: 把 f2 这类无数值标签、刻度间隔 1% 的折线图纳入「按标记可达精度」评估，而不是一刀切的可读/不可读
